name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 3 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-07-21, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.42 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
